description: The announcements were made while inaugurating Google I/O Connect India 2026 at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre (BIEC)
body_lead: After IT City, Karnataka Aims To Be AI Hub: State To Get India’s 1st Artificial Intelligence Varsity, Says CM The announcements were made while inaugurating Google I/O Connect India 2026 at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre (BIEC) Got Question about the News? Karnataka will establish India’s first government-driven Artificial Intelligence (AI) University and an AI Hub to position the state as a global centre for responsible AI innovation, Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar announced on Tuesday.
